title: of the Infrastructure of ARTEX, a Chinese AI Penetration Testing Tool #4 – The Birth of Copy Cat
content_md: Key Summary Since the original ARTEX GitHub repository disappeared, there has been an increase in independent distributions and customized instances based on the existing ARTEX codebase. These distributions are being redistributed with the product name, UI, filesystem structure, agent settings, and language modified, while retaining traces of ARTEX.
